semiconductor_relevance: High — TOWATEC Co., Ltd. specializes in after-sales service for semiconductor manufacturing equipment, which is critical for maintaining operational efficiency in semiconductor fabrication.
summary: TOWATEC Co., Ltd. provides after-sales maintenance services primarily for semiconductor manufacturing equipment and ultra-precision molds. Established in 1997 and headquartered in Kyoto, Japan, the company focuses on supporting the stable operation of TOWA equipment and offers fast maintenance solutions utilizing IoT technology.
capabilities: Sales of maintenance parts and mold parts
Purchase and resale of secondhand TOWA equipment

regional_presence.Japan: TOWATEC is headquartered in Kyoto, Japan, focusing on the local semiconductor manufacturing market.
